description: Defines the SocketTracker class for tracking socket states and activities within the starboard namespace, including socket creation, connection, binding, acceptance, and address resolution. Contains operator overload for SbSocketAddress comparison and manages socket records with thread safety.

classes.name: SocketTracker
classes.description: A singleton class that tracks socket lifecycle events, socket states, and associated addresses, providing thread-safe access and logging functionalities.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SocketTracker.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Records the creation of a socket with its address type and protocol.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Removes tracking information for a socket.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Updates socket state upon connection to a remote address.

methods.name: OnBind
methods.description: Records local address binding for a socket.

methods.name: OnReceiveFrom
methods.description: Records source address for received data.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Records destination address for sent data.

methods.name: IsSocketTracked
methods.description: Checks if a socket is currently being tracked.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address associated with a socket.

methods.name: OnAddWaiter
methods.description: Adds a waiter to a socket.

methods.name: OnRemoveWaiter
methods.description: Removes a waiter from a socket.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a socket.

methods.name: LogTrackedSockets
methods.description: Logs information about all tracked sockets.

methods.name: ComputeIdleTimePerSocketForThreadId
methods.description: Computes idle time per socket for a specific thread ID.
